info.name: EverySkill Backend
info.description: All API endpoints implemented so far: health check, full auth module (register, login, refresh, logout, forgot-password, reset-password, change-password), the customer module (FR2, plus FR11 booking creation/cancellation and FR12 paying for a booking), the provider module (FR3: profile, skills, gallery, certifications, KYC submission, plus FR6 listing management, FR7 AI category recommendation, FR8 availability management, FR11 booking accept/decline/start/complete/cancel, and FR12 payment transaction history), the admin module (FR4: KYC review; FR6: category management; FR24: administrator management), the public Categories/Listings/listing-availability browsing endpoints (FR6/FR8/FR9), AI-powered natural-language search (FR10), and the generic file upload endpoint used by all of the above. Import into Postman, then run 'Auth > Register (Customer)' for the Customer folder, 'Auth > Register (Provider - Individual/Business)' for the Provider folder — tokens are captured into collection variables automatically. For the Admin folder: run `npm run seed` once (with SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL/SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD set in backend/.env) to bootstrap the first SUPER_ADMIN, then run 'Auth > Login (Super Admin)' — every other admin account is created from there via 'Admin > Create Administrator', no public admin-registration endpoint exists. The Uploads request needs a real file attached manually (Postman body > form-data > file field). Run 'Categories > Create Category' and 'Categories > Create Subcategory' (as admin) before 'Provider > Create Listing' — they capture 'categoryId' and 'categoryId2' into collection variables. A listing can belong to multiple categories (categoryIds is an array). Before 'Customer > Create Booking', set up the provider's availability (Provider > Availability folder) covering the scheduledAt you plan to book. For 'Customer > Pay Booking', set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (test mode, sk_test_...) in backend/.env first — the booking must be ACCEPTED before it can be paid. Beyond the original FR12 wording, this also covers (per direct request): a platform commission percentage settable via 'Admin > Update Platform Settings' (SUPER_ADMIN), provider balances/simulated withdrawals ('Provider > Get My Balance'/'Withdraw Balance'), offline payments as an alternative to Stripe at the same pay step ('Customer > Pay Booking (Offline)', with a disclaimer + a commission bill the provider then owes — 'Provider > List My Bills'/'Pay My Bill'), a 5-day-overdue auto-suspension cron job for unpaid bills, and mid-job extra charges requiring customer approval ('Provider > Request Extra Charge', 'Customer > Respond to Extra Charge'/'Pay Extra Charge'). FR13 (Cancellation & Dispute Resolution) adds: reschedule as an alternative to a late cancellation ('Customer/Provider > Propose Reschedule'/'Respond to Reschedule'), no-show marking ('Customer/Provider > Mark No-Show') and late-cancellation tracking that feed a violation-count 'standing' (lateCancellationCount/noShowCount on your own profile) with auto-suspension at 3 violations (manually lifted via 'Admin > Reactivate User', unlike FR12's self-healing suspension), and disputes ('Customer/Provider > Open Dispute', 'Admin > List/Get/Mark Under Review/Resolve Dispute' — resolving can release an escrowed payment, refund one (including a real post-capture Stripe refund + balance clawback), or dismiss the dispute outright). FR14 (In-App Messaging) adds: every booking gets a Conversation automatically at creation — 'Customer/Provider > List Messages'/'Send Message' (text and/or an imageUrl, at least one required; upload the image first via the Uploads folder's public upload endpoint).

item.name: Login (Super Admin)
item.description: There's no public registration endpoint for privileged roles. The first SUPER_ADMIN is bootstrapped by running `npm run seed` once (with SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL/SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD set in backend/.env) — set the 'superAdminPassword' collection variable to match, then log in here. From there, use Admin > Create Administrator to make ADMIN (or additional SUPER_ADMIN) accounts.

item.name: Forgot Password
item.description: No email provider is wired up yet, so the reset token is printed to the backend's console log instead of being emailed. Copy it from there into the 'resetToken' collection variable before running Reset Password.

item.name: Reset Password
item.description: Paste the token logged to the console by 'Forgot Password' into the 'resetToken' collection variable first (Collection > Variables tab).

item.name: Change Password
item.description: Self-service password change for an already-logged-in user (any role) — requires the current password, unlike Forgot/Reset Password. Also revokes the refresh token (other sessions get logged out). Swap {{accessToken}} for {{providerAccessToken}}/{{adminAccessToken}}/{{superAdminAccessToken}} to test other roles.

item.name: Customer
item.description: Requires a CUSTOMER access token — run Auth > Register (Customer) or Login first.

item.name: Get My Dashboard
item.description: FR21. Aggregates profile, recent bookings (+ counts by status), recent payments, favorites, reviews, recent messages (one per conversation), and unread notification count.

item.name: Add Favorite
item.description: Set the 'providerProfileId' collection variable to a real ProviderProfile id first (e.g. from a provider registration response, once that id is exposed — for now, look it up via Prisma Studio).

item.name: Create Booking
item.description: scheduledAt must be in the future, within the provider's declared availability (Provider > Availability folder), and not conflict with another active booking for that provider. price is copied from the listing automatically.

item.name: Get Booking
item.description: Includes statusHistory — the full audit trail of status transitions (FR11).

item.name: Cancel Booking
item.description: cancellationReason is optional. Only valid from REQUESTED/ACCEPTED/IN_PROGRESS — 409 otherwise.

item.name: Pay Booking
item.description: FR12. method is "stripe" (default) or "offline" — see 'Pay Booking (Offline)' below. paymentMethodId optional (defaults to pm_card_visa, Stripe's always-succeeds test card). Use pm_card_chargeDeclined to test a failed payment. Booking must be ACCEPTED first (Provider > Accept Booking). Requires STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (test mode) in backend/.env.

item.name: Pay Booking (Offline)
item.description: Pays the provider directly, bypassing Stripe. Response includes a 'disclaimer' (platform doesn't guarantee offline payments), 'amountDue', and 'platformBill' — the commission the provider now owes the platform (due in 5 days, see Provider > List My Bills).

item.name: Create Review
item.description: FR16. Booking must be COMPLETED and not already reviewed (409 otherwise). rating is 1-5.

item.name: List My Reviews
item.description: FR16. Every review the caller has written, newest first.

item.name: Submit Before Documentation Image
item.description: FR17. Always creates a BEFORE-kind row. Booking must be ACCEPTED or IN_PROGRESS.

item.name: List Booking Documentation (Customer)
item.description: FR17. All documentation rows (BEFORE/COMPLETION/AFTER) for this booking, oldest first.

item.name: Respond to Extra Charge
item.description: approve: true increases the booking's price by the charge amount; approve: false rejects it with no further effect. Run Provider > Request Extra Charge first to populate 'chargeId'.

item.name: Pay Extra Charge
item.description: Charge must be APPROVED first. method is "stripe" (immediate capture, not escrowed) or "offline" (same disclaimer/bill shape as Pay Booking (Offline)).

item.name: Propose Reschedule
item.description: FR13 — an alternative to a late cancellation. Booking must be ACCEPTED/IN_PROGRESS; only one PENDING request allowed at a time. Captures the request id into 'rescheduleRequestId'.

item.name: Respond to Reschedule
item.description: Must be the OTHER party from whoever proposed it (409 otherwise). approve: true moves the booking to the proposed time; approve: false rejects it, booking unchanged.

item.name: Mark No-Show (Provider)
item.description: FR13 — customer marks the PROVIDER as a no-show. No body. Booking must be ACCEPTED/IN_PROGRESS with scheduledAt already in the past (400 otherwise). Cancels the booking and logs a violation against the provider's standing.

item.name: Open Dispute
item.description: Booking must be ACCEPTED/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED; one dispute per booking. Moves the booking to DISPUTED (freezing normal actions until an admin resolves it). Captures the id into 'disputeId'.

item.name: List Messages
item.description: FR14. Oldest first, each including sender { id, email, role }. Returns [] for a booking with no messages yet (never 404 for a booking you own).

item.name: Send Message
item.description: content and imageUrl are each optional but at least one is required (text-only, image-only, or both). For an image, upload it first via Uploads > Upload File (Public) and pass the returned url as imageUrl here.

item.name: List My Notifications
item.description: FR15. Newest first. Optional ?unreadOnly=true restricts to unread only.

item.name: Get Notifications Unread Count
item.description: FR15. { unreadCount: number }.

item.name: Mark Notification Read
item.description: FR15. Marks a single notification read. 404 if it does not exist or belongs to someone else.

item.name: Mark All Notifications Read
item.description: FR15. { updated: number }.

item.name: Delete My Account (GDPR)
item.description: Irreversible in practice (see docs). Only run this against a throwaway test account.

item.name: Compare Before/After (Customer, AI)
item.description: FR20. Same as the provider version.

item.name: Provider
item.description: Requires a PROVIDER access token — run Auth > Register (Provider - Individual/Business) first.

item.name: Get My Dashboard
item.description: FR22. Aggregates profile, services (listings), schedule (availability), recent bookings + counts by status, earnings (balance/recent payments/withdrawals/pending bills), analytics (booking counts + rating), reviews, certifications, verification status + KYC docs, recent messages, unread notification count.

item.name: Recommend Category (AI)
item.description: FR7 — advisory only, doesn't create anything. Returns { category: {id, name}, confidence, reasoning } drawn from your existing Category list (run Categories > Create Category first if none exist). Requires GROQ_API_KEY set in backend/.env (free key at console.groq.com) — without it this returns 500.

item.name: Recommend Category From Image (AI)
item.description: FR20. Vision counterpart to FR7's text-based recommend-category. Advisory only.

item.name: Analyze Image (Detect Service Objects, AI)
item.description: FR20. Returns { objects: string[], description: string }. Not tied to any specific listing.

item.name: Create Listing

body.raw:
{
  "categoryIds": ["{{categoryId}}", "{{categoryId2}}"],
  "title": "Emergency Leak Repair",
  "description": "Same-day callout for burst pipes and leaks.",
  "pricingType": "FIXED",
  "price": 75.00,
  "durationMinutes": 60,
  "images": ["https://example.com/listing1.jpg"],
  "serviceArea": "Greater London",
  "tags": ["plumbing", "emergency"],
  "cancellationCutoffHours": 24
}

item.description: categoryIds is a non-empty array — a listing can belong to multiple categories. Run Categories > Create Category and Create Subcategory (as admin) first to populate 'categoryId' and 'categoryId2'. pricingType is FIXED (price = total for the whole task) or HOURLY (price = rate per hour) — see 'Create Listing (Hourly)' for the other mode.

item.name: Create Listing (Hourly)

body.raw:
{
  "categoryIds": ["{{categoryId}}"],
  "title": "General Handyman Services",
  "description": "Odd jobs billed by the hour — furniture assembly, small repairs, mounting.",
  "pricingType": "HOURLY",
  "price": 25.00,
  "durationMinutes": 60,
  "tags": ["handyman"]
}

item.description: Same endpoint as 'Create Listing' but pricingType: HOURLY — here price (25.00) is the rate charged per hour, not a total. durationMinutes is still the estimated/scheduled duration used for booking slots.

item.name: Update My Listing
item.description: Any subset of the create fields, plus isActive: false to unpublish without deleting. categoryIds REPLACES the full set of categories (here, dropping categoryId2 and keeping only categoryId) — it must stay non-empty.

item.name: Get Listing Completeness (AI-adjacent, deterministic)
item.description: FR19. Deterministic checklist (no AI call) — missing images, short description, no tags, no service area.

item.name: Improve Listing Description (AI)
item.description: FR19. Returns { improvedDescription, reasoning }. Advisory only — does not modify the listing.

item.name: Suggest Listing Keywords (AI)
item.description: FR19. Returns { keywords: string[], reasoning }.

item.name: Create Availability Slot (Recurring)
item.description: dayOfWeek is 0 (Sunday) through 6 (Saturday) — this creates a weekly-repeating open window every Monday 9am-5pm. Captures the id into 'slotId'.

item.name: Create Availability Slot (Blocked Date)
item.description: date (not dayOfWeek) blocks one specific calendar date — e.g. a holiday. isBlocked windows are allowed to overlap open windows (that's how a lunch-break carve-out works); two OPEN windows overlapping on the same day/date get a 409.

item.name: Update Availability Slot
item.description: Any subset of the create fields. To switch a slot from recurring to specific-date (or vice versa), pass the other field explicitly as null.

item.name: Upload KYC Document (Private)
item.description: Uploads to the PRIVATE KYC bucket (unlike the generic Uploads > Upload File request). Select a real file for the 'file' field before sending. Run this before 'Submit KYC Document' — it captures the returned path into the 'documentPath' variable.

item.name: Submit KYC Document
item.description: documentType is IDENTITY (individuals), or BUSINESS_REGISTRATION / REPRESENTATIVE_IDENTITY (businesses). Run 'Upload KYC Document (Private)' first to populate documentPath.

item.name: Get My KYC Document URL
item.description: Returns a signed URL valid for 10 minutes.

item.name: Get My Booking
item.description: Includes statusHistory — the full audit trail of status transitions (FR11).

item.name: Accept Booking
item.description: No body. REQUESTED -> ACCEPTED. 409 if the booking isn't currently REQUESTED.

item.name: Decline Booking
item.description: No body. REQUESTED -> DECLINED.

item.name: Start Booking
item.description: No body. ACCEPTED -> IN_PROGRESS.

item.name: Complete Booking
item.description: No body. IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED.

item.name: Cancel Booking (Provider)
item.description: cancellationReason optional. Valid from REQUESTED/ACCEPTED/IN_PROGRESS.

item.name: Request Extra Charge
item.description: Booking must be ACCEPTED or IN_PROGRESS. Captures the new charge's id into 'chargeId' — the customer must approve it (Customer > Respond to Extra Charge) before it can be paid.

item.name: List My Payments
item.description: FR12 transaction history — every payment across bookings for your listings, including each payment's booking.

item.name: Get My Balance
item.description: Credited automatically (net of platform commission) whenever a Stripe payment or extra charge is released.

item.name: Withdraw Balance
item.description: amount optional — omit to withdraw the entire available balance. Simulated: no real bank transfer, just marks the ledger amount as paid out.

item.name: List My Bills
item.description: Commission owed on offline-paid bookings/extra charges. Unpaid past 5 days -> account suspended (see docs/API.md).

item.name: Pay My Bill
item.description: method is "stripe" (charges the provider directly) or "balance" (deducts from their own platform balance instead, {"method":"balance"} with no paymentMethodId). Paying off your last overdue bill auto-reactivates a suspended account.

item.name: Propose Reschedule
item.description: FR13 — an alternative to a late cancellation. Booking must be ACCEPTED/IN_PROGRESS; only one PENDING request allowed at a time. Captures the request id into 'rescheduleRequestId'.

item.name: Respond to Reschedule
item.description: Must be the OTHER party from whoever proposed it (409 otherwise). approve: true moves the booking to the proposed time; approve: false rejects it, booking unchanged.

item.name: Mark No-Show (Customer)
item.description: FR13 — provider marks the CUSTOMER as a no-show. No body. Booking must be ACCEPTED/IN_PROGRESS with scheduledAt already in the past (400 otherwise). Cancels the booking and logs a violation against the customer's standing.

item.name: Open Dispute
item.description: Booking must be ACCEPTED/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED; one dispute per booking. Moves the booking to DISPUTED. Captures the id into 'disputeId'.

item.name: List Messages
item.description: FR14. Oldest first, each including sender { id, email, role }. Returns [] for a booking with no messages yet (never 404 for a booking you own).

item.name: Send Message
item.description: content and imageUrl are each optional but at least one is required (text-only, image-only, or both). For an image, upload it first via Uploads > Upload File (Public) and pass the returned url as imageUrl here.

item.name: List My Notifications
item.description: FR15. Newest first. Optional ?unreadOnly=true restricts to unread only.

item.name: Get Notifications Unread Count
item.description: FR15. { unreadCount: number }.

item.name: Mark Notification Read
item.description: FR15. Marks a single notification read. 404 if it does not exist or belongs to someone else.

item.name: Mark All Notifications Read
item.description: FR15. { updated: number }.

item.name: List Reviews About Me
item.description: FR16. Every review written about the caller, newest first, including customer name.

item.name: Reply to Review
item.description: FR16. One-time reply (409 if this review already has one).

item.name: Submit Completion/After Documentation Image
item.description: FR17. kind is COMPLETION or AFTER. Booking must be IN_PROGRESS. Both kinds are required before PATCH .../complete will succeed.

item.name: List Booking Documentation (Provider)
item.description: FR17. All documentation rows for this booking, oldest first.

item.name: Compare Before/After (Provider, AI)
item.description: FR20. Requires both a BEFORE and an AFTER ServiceDocumentation image to already exist (409 otherwise). Returns { verdict, confidence, reasoning }.

item.name: Admin
item.description: KYC requests require an ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN access token. Administrator-management requests (bottom of this folder) require SUPER_ADMIN specifically. Bootstrap the first SUPER_ADMIN via `npm run seed`, then run Auth > Login (Super Admin).

item.name: List Administrators
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN only. Returns every ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN account.

item.name: Create Administrator
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN only. role is "ADMIN" or "SUPER_ADMIN" (defaults to ADMIN). Captures the new account's id into 'newAdminUserId' — run 'Auth > Login (New Admin)' afterward to get a usable adminAccessToken.

item.name: Login (New Admin)
item.description: Logs in as the account created by 'Create Administrator', populating 'adminAccessToken' for the KYC requests below.

item.name: Force-Reset Administrator Password
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN only. Directly sets the target ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN account's password (offboarding/lockout recovery) — no email/token round-trip. Revokes their refresh token and clears any pending self-service reset token.

item.name: Get Platform Settings
item.description: ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Auto-creates a default 10% commission the first time this is read.

item.name: Update Platform Settings (Commission)
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN only (FR24 'Commissions'). commissionPercent is 0-100, deducted whenever a payment or extra charge is released to a provider.

item.name: Reactivate User
item.description: FR13 — manually lifts a SUSPENDED account (e.g. from 3 logged violations). No body. 409 if the target isn't currently SUSPENDED. Set 'targetUserId' to the suspended user's id first.

item.name: List Disputes
item.description: Optional ?status=OPEN|UNDER_REVIEW|RESOLVED|REJECTED filter. Each includes the full booking (customer, providerProfile, listing, payment).

item.name: Mark Dispute Under Review
item.description: No body. Only valid from status OPEN (409 otherwise) — a lightweight bookkeeping step before a final decision.

item.name: Resolve Dispute
item.description: decision is "REFUND_CUSTOMER" (booking -> CANCELLED; refunds the escrow, or issues a real Stripe refund + balance clawback if already captured), "RELEASE_PROVIDER" (booking -> COMPLETED; captures the escrow and credits the provider's balance, or no-ops if already released), or "DISMISS" (booking -> COMPLETED, no payment action, dispute -> REJECTED). 409 if already resolved/rejected.

item.name: Reject KYC Request
item.description: rejectionReason is required when status is REJECTED.

item.name: Get KYC Document URL
item.description: Returns a signed URL valid for 10 minutes, for reviewing any provider's document.

item.name: List Reports
item.description: FR18. Optional ?status filter. Oldest first (FIFO moderation queue).

item.name: Get Report
item.description: FR18.

item.name: Mark Report Reviewed
item.description: FR18. PENDING -> REVIEWED (optional step before .../action).

item.name: Action Report (Warn)
item.description: FR18. action is WARN|SUSPEND|BAN|DISMISS. For non-USER targets, resolves to the underlying user (review author / message sender / listing owner).

item.name: Action Report (Suspend)
item.description: FR18.

item.name: Action Report (Ban)
item.description: FR18.

item.name: Action Report (Dismiss)
item.description: FR18.

item.name: List My Notifications (Admin)
item.description: FR15/FR18. Admins previously had no notification endpoints at all — added alongside FR18 since REPORT_FILED is the first thing that notifies them.

item.name: Get Notifications Unread Count (Admin)
item.description: FR15/FR18.

item.name: Mark Notification Read (Admin)
item.description: FR15/FR18.

item.name: Mark All Notifications Read (Admin)
item.description: FR15/FR18.

item.name: List All Users
item.description: FR23. Optional ?role and ?status filters, combinable.

item.name: List All Reviews (Admin)
item.description: FR23. Every review platform-wide, newest first.

item.name: List Audit Log
item.description: FR23. Optional ?action and ?targetType filters. Capped at 100 rows, newest first.

item.name: Get Platform Analytics
item.description: FR23. Platform-wide counts: users, bookings, revenue (approximate), reports, disputes, reviews.

item.name: Get Admin Dashboard
item.description: FR23. Aggregates users, verification (KYC), reviews, categories, reports, disputes, analytics, and audit log.

item.name: Categories
item.description: GET is public. POST/PATCH/DELETE require an ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN access token — see Admin folder for how to get one.

item.name: Create Subcategory
item.description: parentId is optional — omit it to create a top-level category. Captures its id into 'categoryId2', so Provider > Create Listing can attach a listing to two categories at once.

item.name: Update Category
item.description: Pass parentId: null to move a category back to top-level.

item.name: Delete Category
item.description: Fails with 409 if the category has subcategories or listings attached.

item.name: Listings (Public)
item.description: No auth required. Only returns listings with isActive: true.

item.name: Search Listings (Filtered)
item.description: All query params are optional and combinable: categoryId, providerProfileId, search (title/description, case-insensitive), pricingType (HOURLY or FIXED), minPrice, maxPrice, providerType, verified, location, availableDate, latitude/longitude/radiusKm (distance search).

item.name: Search Listings (Distance)
item.description: FR9 distance search. latitude, longitude, and radiusKm must all be provided together (400 otherwise). Only providers who've set their own latitude/longitude (Provider > Update My Profile) are considered. Results get a distanceKm field and are sorted nearest-first instead of newest-first.

item.name: Search Listings (Availability & Verification)
item.description: FR9 availability/verification/provider-type filters. availableDate only matches providers with a declared open slot for that date (recurring weekly or specific) and no full-day block.

item.name: AI Search (FR10)
item.description: No auth required. Understands natural language, extracts category/budget/location/date/urgency via Groq, runs the normal search with those filters, and returns { interpretation, results } where each result has a matchReasons array explaining the match. Requires GROQ_API_KEY (same as FR7's Recommend Category) — without it, returns 500.

item.name: Get Listing Availability
item.description: Resolves the listing to its owning provider and returns that provider's AvailabilitySlot rows (FR8) — lets a customer see open/blocked windows before booking.

item.name: Get Listing Reviews
item.description: FR16. Public. Reviews for bookings of this listing, newest first, with customer {firstName,lastName}.

item.name: File Report (against User)

body.raw:
{
  "targetType": "USER",
  "targetId": "{{targetUserId}}",
  "reason": "SCAM_PROVIDER",
  "description": "Took payment offline and never showed up",
  "images": []
}

item.description: FR18. Any authenticated user, any role (bidirectional). targetType is USER|REVIEW|MESSAGE|LISTING; targetId must reference a real row of that type (404 otherwise).

item.name: File Report (against Listing)
item.description: FR18. Actioning this report (WARN/SUSPEND/BAN) resolves to the listing's owning provider, not the reporter.

item.name: List My Reports
item.description: FR18. Every report the caller has filed, newest first.

item.name: Uploads
item.description: Public upload endpoint (see Provider folder for the private KYC upload). Requires any valid access token (customer/provider/admin).

item.name: Upload File (Public)
item.description: In Postman, open the Body tab and select a real file for the 'file' field before sending. Allowed types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, max 10MB. Response is { "url": "..." } — use that URL in profileImage/coverImage/fileUrl/galleryImages fields elsewhere. This is the PUBLIC bucket — do NOT use it for KYC documents, use Provider > Upload KYC Document (Private) instead. Swap {{accessToken}} for {{providerAccessToken}} or {{adminAccessToken}} depending on which account you're uploading as.
